channel.title: BOOM Fact Check: Debunking Misinformation and Fake news
channel.description: BOOM Fact Check: A premier destination for factchecking and debunking fake news and misinformation in India. As a trusted authority, BOOM specializes in debunking fake news and viral falsehoods found in photos and videos on social media, ensuring information integrity through rigorous verification processes.

item.title: Deepfakes Targeting Indian Army Personnel Shared Amid Kulgam Attack
item.description: BOOM found visual inconsistencies in the videos that indicate they were made using AI.
item.content:encoded:
Deepfakes of Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and others have surfaced with false claims that they made negative remarks about the Indian Army.

BOOM found that the videos have been digitally altered and their voices cloned to make such statements.

item.title: Image Of Indian Embassy Counsellor At Anti-Pak Protest Is Digitally Altered
item.description: BOOM found that the image has been digitally manipulated and it does not show Deepak Raghu, from the Indian Embassy
item.content:encoded:
A digitally altered image is being shared with the claim that it shows Deepak Raghu, an Indian Embassy counsellor, attending a Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC) protest in London against the political crackdown in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.

BOOM found that the image has been digitally manipulated and the man is not Raghu.

item.title: Arunachal On Edge: India-China Face-Off Fuel A Flood Of Misinformation
item.description: As reports of India-China border tensions emerged from Arunachal Pradesh, deepfakes, old videos and unrelated footage flooded social media with misleading claims.
item.content:encoded:
Days after the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) chief confirmed reports of fresh face-offs between Indian and Chinese troops in Arunachal Pradesh on October 22, deepfakes of senior Indian Army officers purportedly admitting that China had occupied parts of the state began circulating on social media.

The officers had made no such statements. [trimmed]
item.dc:creator: Anmol Alphonso

item.title: Viral Video Of Monkeys Frightened By Diwali Firecrackers Is AI Slop
item.description: BOOM found visual inconsistencies indicating it was created using AI
item.content:encoded:
An AI-generated video appearing to show three monkeys startled by fireworks is being shared on social media as footage of a real incident during Diwali.

BOOM found the original video with an AI label; two AI-detection tools also flagged the footage as likely AI-generated.

The Claim:
The video is being shared on social media to show the distress caused by fireworks to animals during Diwali.

[trimmed]
